title: 3dRSFC
description: Program to calculate common resting state functional connectivity (RSFC) parameters.

fbot.description: Lowest frequency in the passband, in Hz
fbot.title: Frequency Band Bottom

ftop.description: Highest frequency in the passband (must be > fbot)
ftop.title: Frequency Band Top

despike.description: Despike each time series before other processing.
despike.title: Despike Flag

ort_file.description: Also orthogonalize input to columns in specified file.
ort_file.title: Ort File

dsort_file.description: Orthogonalize each voxel to the corresponding voxel time series in specified dataset.
dsort_file.title: Dsort File

nodetrend.description: Skip the quadratic detrending of input before FFT-based bandpassing.
nodetrend.title: No Detrend Flag

time_step.description: Set time step to specified value in seconds.
time_step.title: Time Step

nfft.description: Set the FFT length to specified value.
nfft.title: NFFT Value

norm.description: Make all output time series have L2 norm = 1.
norm.title: Normalize Flag

automask.description: Create a mask from the input dataset.
automask.title: Automask Flag

blur.description: Blur inside the mask only with specified FWHM in mm.
blur.title: Blur FWHM

localpv.description: Replace each vector by the local Principal Vector from a neighborhood radius.
localpv.title: LocalPV Radius

input_alt.description: Alternative way to specify input dataset.
input_alt.title: Input Dataset Alternative

band.description: Alternative way to specify passband frequencies.
band.title: Passband Frequencies

prefix.description: Set prefix name of the output dataset.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

quiet.description: Turn off the fun and informative messages.
quiet.title: Quiet Flag

no_rs_out.description: Don't output processed time series, just output parameters.
no_rs_out.title: No RS Output Flag

un_bandpass_out.description: Output the un-bandpassed series as well.
un_bandpass_out.title: Un-Bandpass Output Flag

no_rsfa.description: Exclude RSFA output (default is to include).
no_rsfa.title: No RSFA Flag

bp_at_end.description: Bandpassing as the last step in the processing sequence.
bp_at_end.title: Bandpass at End Flag

notrans.description: Don't check for initial positive transients in the data.
notrans.title: No Transients Flag

nosat.description: Equivalent to -notrans, skips checking for initial transients.
nosat.title: No Saturation Flag
